head: 384e34e
closure_claim_withheld_because: S3-AC-001..200 are not all executably verified; the frontend, browser end-to-end, mutation, coverage and runbook obligations remain.

deferral_kinds.EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE: needs a fact about the real world this product must not invent
deferral_kinds.OWNER_POLICY: needs a versioned, owner-attributed policy decision
deferral_kinds.GATE: needs an exact Human Owner gate authorization
deferral_kinds.DELIVERABLE: in-scope engineering work that is not finished

register.obligation: real Ozon advertising read capability, native object hierarchy, Spend/traffic/attribution semantics, source maturity and account/store evidence.
register.fails_closed_because: No real Ozon call is made or reachable. platform.ad_semantic_profile carries a SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE profile that the schema forbids promoting to VERIFIED, and PlatformHttpAdBidWriteAdapter refuses before any socket when no verified operation exists.

register.obligation: equivalent real Wildberries advertising read evidence without assuming Ozon symmetry.
register.fails_closed_because: Wildberries is a separate platform_code with its own capability, profile and endpoint rows. Nothing in the code branches on platform, so absence of Wildberries evidence is absence of rows rather than a disabled branch.
fail_closed_evidence: PlatformHttpAdBidWriteAdapter: no Ozon or Wildberries branch exists

register.obligation: real Product Mapping, native-object lineage and complete affected-set coverage for the intended operating cohort.
register.fails_closed_because: core.ad_affected_set records resolution_state and unresolved_reason_codes; a set that did not resolve COMPLETE cannot be reserved against and therefore cannot produce a command.

register.obligation: real company Order/Completed/Retained sales and deterministic ad-linked sale-event evidence, including Provider-to-canonical attribution-gap profile.
register.fails_closed_because: ledger.ad_linked_sale_event is empty. Every measure derived from it is NOT_AVAILABLE rather than zero, and the outcome path reports INDETERMINATE with a named reason.

register.obligation: real official advertising Spend reconciliation and correction-window evidence.
register.fails_closed_because: ledger.ad_object_fact carries report_window_complete and correction_window_open; an open correction window downgrades evidence to PROVISIONAL_OR_ESTIMATED, which is not write-grade.

register.obligation: real COGS, fee, fulfillment, return-loss, Settlement and Adjustment inputs sufficient for Operational and Settled advertising profit.
register.fails_closed_because: No promotion-cost feed exists, so AdvertisingContributionProfit blocks on PROMOTION_COST_PER_UNIT and both profit axes stay absent rather than becoming a profit with a component missing.
fail_closed_evidence: AdvertisingCaseCalculationService: promotionCostPerUnit is notAvailable by construction

register.obligation: real stage-consistent Conversion, Allowable CPA and Max CPC definitions and approved evidence.
register.fails_closed_because: core.ad_conversion_definition and core.ad_allowable_cpa_definition are empty in every environment. MaxCpc.compute returns ALLOWABLE_CPA_UNRESOLVED, and a candidate cannot be generated without a write-grade ceiling unless a cause-bound policy names the cause.

register.obligation: real source/platform/purpose Freshness Profiles for Queue, Task, Recommendation, Write, Compensation and Outcomes.
register.fails_closed_because: core.ad_freshness_profile is purpose-scoped and empty; core.ad_freshness_purpose_violations reports every purpose that cannot be satisfied.

register.obligation: real Optimization qualification, Target, Outcome, Priority, human-SLO, Approval-Lease and aggregate-Exposure Policies with owners and evidence.
register.fails_closed_because: Seven policy families, each versioned, owner-attributed and evidence-referenced. Absent rows resolve to nothing rather than to a default; a missing human-SLO profile falls back to the tightest window so the gap is visible as urgency.

register.obligation: one complete, compatible, scope-bound Advertising Decision Policy Bundle accepted for each intended real operating scope.
register.fails_closed_because: No ACTIVE bundle can exist: whole-combination validation requires a VERIFIED, non-SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE semantic profile, which this Slice deliberately does not have. The gate therefore reports BUNDLE_UNRESOLVED for every command.
fail_closed_evidence: V0041: ad_bundle_validation_failures and the activation trigger

register.obligation: real OIDC/MFA, user disable/revoke, Role/Scope and role-minimal disclosure evidence.
register.fails_closed_because: iam.identity_provider cannot be ACTIVE without VERIFIED state and an MFA claim vocabulary; AD_BID_CHANGE_APPROVE is a step-up action scope.

register.obligation: real Operating Calendar, staffed Coverage, escalation, Daily Brief and Weekly Review ownership.
register.fails_closed_because: core.ad_human_slo_profile carries staffed coverage and escalation minutes. The Daily Brief and Weekly Review console surfaces are not built.

register.obligation: real governed Shadow evidence under preaccepted sample, duration, discrepancy, manual-verification and operating-SLO thresholds.
register.fails_closed_because: The Manual Shadow records and never routes. What is deferred is the accepted sample size, duration and discrepancy thresholds, not the mechanism.

register.obligation: real Ozon `AD_BID_CHANGE` endpoint, permission, unit, step, quota, idempotency/NOT_APPLIED, error, propagation and Readback evidence for each consumed scope.
register.fails_closed_because: The endpoint, quota, idempotency and readback semantics are registry rows this product does not have. Five refusals happen before any socket, and the attempt-opening function refuses before an attempt row exists.

register.obligation: real Wildberries `AD_BID_CHANGE` capability evidence if that Provider path is to become reachable; otherwise verified Shadow-only fail-closed state.
register.fails_closed_because: Absent Wildberries evidence leaves that path Shadow-only and fail-closed by the same mechanism as Ozon: no verified capability, no command.
fail_closed_evidence: V0045: ops.create_ad_bid_command raises MO092 without a VERIFIED capability

register.obligation: exact Gate EV envelope and Human Owner authorization before the first real write for each Platform/Store/Direction/Candidate Basis.
register.fails_closed_because: Gate EV is NOT_AUTHORIZED. Full-Scope Implementation and merge do not authorize a real verification write; that needs an exact Gate-EV envelope per Platform, Store, Direction and Candidate Basis.

register.obligation: exact Gate EV Write/Readback evidence and, when API Compensation is claimed, exact prior-value Compensation round-trip evidence.
register.fails_closed_because: No write has been transmitted, so no readback or compensation round-trip evidence exists. The compensation path refuses without a current readback proving this command still owns the bid.

register.obligation: layered scope-monotonic Gate E Pilot Evidence Bundle, exact allowlist, aggregate Exposure, recovery headroom and operating ownership.
register.fails_closed_because: Gate E is NOT_AUTHORIZED and no Pilot is enabled. The allowlist, aggregate exposure and reserved recovery headroom exist as data and are read by the gate.

register.obligation: real Provider-transmission Kill/Quarantine drill and cause-specific multi-party reenablement evidence.
register.fails_closed_because: The kill and quarantine mechanism is exercised against a real server; what is deferred is a drill against a real provider transmission. Reenablement already requires five conditions, two different people, and an attestation for a technical or security cause.

register.obligation: real early Completed-Sales Guard evidence for the Gate E entry scope and continuing 30-day/Settled Outcome obligations.
register.fails_closed_because: The early Completed-Sales Guard is a check constraint, so a settled claim that outruns it cannot be written. What is deferred is real sales data to guard.

register.obligation: real Operational/Settled baseline, critical-sales-unit and settlement-attribution evidence for mature Outcome reporting.
register.fails_closed_because: Baselines are computed from the same tables and the same window length as the observation. What is deferred is the data, and the critical-sales-unit register.

register.obligation: real Ordinary-route promotion evidence before any Owner per-command delegation is activated; absent evidence keeps every nonzero action Material.
register.fails_closed_because: ops.ad_decision_policy_bundle.ordinary_promotion_id is null everywhere and the gate refuses an ordinary-routed command outright, so every nonzero action stays Material.
fail_closed_evidence: V0045: materiality resolved from policy, never assumed

register.obligation: Yandex runtime, managed PostgreSQL, immutable object custody, backup/PITR/restore, monitoring, security and legal/data-localization release evidence.
register.fails_closed_because: No deployment, shared environment or production runtime is touched by this Slice. Migrations are proven on PostgreSQL 18.4 and 17.6 in disposable containers only.

register.obligation: Key User training/adoption, runbooks, release traceability and no unresolved release-blocking defect for the exact real scope.
register.fails_closed_because: The eleven required runbooks are not written and Key User training has not happened. This is in-scope engineering work that remains, not an external dependency.
